description: Paid (price: see tabularium_menu). Use to answer what was spent, on what, and why. Exports and verifies the workspace, then totals the receipts tabularium_pay wrote: spend overall, by service and by day, with the latest receipts, and checks each receipt's payer-signed intent against the receipt. Optional day_prefix narrows it (e.g. 2026-10 or 2026-10-26).
name: tabularium_ledger
title: What have I spent?
